summary: Kixx was U.S. Gold's budget-price re-release label, used to return older catalogue titles to retail at a lower price. Contemporary industry-history material records that U.S. Gold created the label after its earlier Americana budget arrangement, with former Bulldog and Mastertronic sales manager John Mearman running Kixx.
facts: Kixx was a budget-price label of U.S. Gold.
The Mastertronic Collectors Archive records that U.S. Gold created Kixx after the Americana budget arrangement.
John Mearman, previously associated with Bulldog and Mastertronic, managed the Kixx label.
note: Kixx is treated as a separate re-release publisher archive so its budget editions remain discoverable without replacing the original publisher credit.

sources.label: Mastertronic Collectors Archive — republished software labels

summary: The Hit Squad was a budget re-release label used by Ocean Software, returning Ocean titles and games from other publishers to shops at lower prices. The label is strongly represented across 8-bit and 16-bit formats, with surviving releases covering arcade conversions, licensed games, sports titles and other catalogue reissues.
facts: The Hit Squad was used as a budget label by Ocean Software.
MobyGames records the label as being used from 1989 to around 1996 for budget releases.
The label re-released games originally associated with Ocean and with other publishers including Domark, Activision, Electronic Arts, Taito and Virgin.
note: Earlier Hit Squad-branded compilations also survive in collections; this profile focuses on the label's role as a budget re-release route in the CCG publisher archive.

sources.label: Centre for Computing History — The Hit Squad game archive
MobyGames — The Hit Squad company profile

summary: Ricochet was Mastertronic's budget re-release label for bringing previously full-price software back to market. The Mastertronic Collectors Archive dates the label to July 1987 and records licensed catalogue material from publishers including Martech, Activision and Melbourne House.
facts: Ricochet was a budget re-release label run by Mastertronic.
The Mastertronic Collectors Archive dates the launch of Ricochet to July 1987.
Its catalogue drew on previously released games licensed from several full-price publishers.
note: Ricochet remains a separate archive route because the re-release label is historically useful alongside each game's original publisher credit.
